spec.description: One news headline an office has posted.

office_id.description: Three-letter office code, such as `AKQ`. `points.get_point` returns it as `gridId`.

headline_id.description: Headline id, such as `058e41fd34b935b395e9aaf0fe175dc9`. `offices.list_headlines` returns it as `id`.

notes: `refresh_examples.py` repoints the example to the first headline `offices.list_headlines` records for the same office before every re-recording, since an office retires its headlines.
